gate.deniedHint: Allow this site to use your location, then try again. On iPhone: turn on Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services and set “Safari Websites” to “While Using the App”, or tap the aA button in the address bar > Website Settings > Location > Allow. Until then the map stays on your country’s capital.
